Learn the don't-flush rule and set up a bag toilet
Stock three days of food that needs no cooking
Write the medication list and build a buffer

Write each commuter's get-home plan
Set aside cash in small bills
Scan the key documents into protected storage
Pack a bag by the door
Get a battery radio and write the stations on it
Swap numbers with the neighbors on your floor
Ask building management the outage questions
Pick your cool room and your warm room
Build the home first-aid kit and book a class
